CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2584 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b. Bus nonce: 4c799023a1d8027c0080d2363644d4f8. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b` or `Fix review: blocked 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4c799023a1d8027c0080d2363644d4f8`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2584 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2584-4c799023`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW of PR #2584 (group R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE, branch fix/r10-flow-main-gate) at moved head 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b. The previous verdict, at bf10abe6, was blocked carry-missing: not carried to R10-ORCH-MACHINERY. Read it with `git fetch origin review/2584; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`. Since then the fixer absorbed main b787c7d4, replaced the readers carry on the roster with one stating its e7c66485 replay control (roster ac793561 append, e5d5c508 drop), relabelled "Finder's harness" as the fixer's own (90a0a68f3), fixed a semantic conflict in commit 70a1a1fb (main's #2444 merge_pr offline self-test clone lacked merge_train.py), and applied ci_predict --apply-inert in 37d1d0d3. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head, using the finder's harness the group brief names. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.

- Confirm the carry-missing block is cleared: carry_audit.py check over the body, with and without --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, reports 0 unrouted, and the R10-ORCH-MACHINERY carry is on the roster with its control. Every Carry you write names a live group on main's roster.
- Judge the main-absorb resolutions: dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py (union of main's S35-S38 and andon mutants with the PR's per-file ids; no side's mutant dropped — compare `git show <pre-absorb head>:<file>` and `git show b787c7d4:<file>` with the head), INSTRUMENTS.md merge_pr.sh entry, closures.json. Check `git diff b787c7d4 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b` for anything beyond the PR's own change.
- Judge 70a1a1fb on architecture: is copying the real merge_train.py into the self-test clone sound, or does it mask a dependency merge_pr.sh should not have? Confirm the merge_pr self-test is 18/0 and fails when the copy is removed.
- Judge 37d1d0d3: is the inert classification of the entities.py -> orchestrator_tick.py read correct per tests/closure.py?
- Re-run the mutation proof (body: 71 KILLED, 0 survivors), self-tests (merge_train 219/0, orchestrator_tick 190/0, merge_pr 18/0, wiring 76/76), with a null control for every quantified claim. Re-measure every figure in the body. The fixer did not re-run r10_main_gate_replay.py; decide whether its figures stand (merge_train.py byte-unchanged since bf10abe6 is claimed — verify).
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" / "API is unreachable" is external. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 37d1d0d38fd0ef449c55abe49f6c70b0604b8e4b must be clean.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 4c799023a1d8027c0080d2363644d4f8. No /Users/ or /private/ path in VERDICT.md or ev/.
